reason: The hypothesis combines boron doping (from P2/P4) with deep cryogenic treatment (from P20) into a single synergistic intervention for the same alloy, which no single passage proposes. It also extends the evaluation to dynamic high-strain-rate conditions and energetic energy release, a gap not addressed by the cited studies. This integration of two distinct strengthening/ductilizing strategies from separate papers into one testable proposal represents a synthesis.
